messages:
From: Alice Gomez <alice@acme-corp.com>

Cc: Infra Team <infra-team@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Edge VPC cutover timing

Hi Nikhil — thanks for the quick catch-up yesterday. We want to lock the cutover window for the Edge VPC to next Monday 2027-05-17 02:00–04:00 UTC. Before we commit, two asks from our side: (1) a short, sequenced checklist we can run in the first 30 minutes to validate networking config and KMS, and (2) a compact observability playback (what traces/metrics we’ll look at during the first 4 hours). Can your team produce those artifacts so our infra lead (sam.li) can review before the bridge?

Thanks,
Alice
Senior Cloud Ops, AcmeCorp

Attachment: none
From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
To: Alice Gomez <alice@acme-corp.com>, Infra Team <infra-team@acme-corp.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-16T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Edge VPC cutover timing

Alice — we can do that. Quick summary of what we’ll hand over before your bridge:

- 30-min verification checklist (sequenced): network ACLs, route-table drift, VPN peer status, KMS key access check, DNS resolution, load‑balancer health, SG/NSG snapshot.
- Observability playback doc: top-10 traces to watch, baseline 95th/99th latency, token‑level throughput, error-rate thresholds, and quick remediation commands.
- Runbook for rollback and hotfix patching if PKI or KMS problems surface.

I’m attaching the runbook draft and a one‑page checklist for your review. Hannah will lead the runbook playback during the bridge; Vivek will own observability queries. Lauren will coordinate the post-cutover verification slots. Expect the artifacts in the next 30–45 minutes. If the 02:00–04:00 UTC window is still ok, we’ll schedule the bridge and invite your infra lead.

— Nikhil
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: runbook_playback_v2.pdf (draft), postcutover_observability_checklist.xlsx (summary)
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: Alice Gomez <alice@acme-corp.com>, Infra Team <infra-team@acme-corp.com>, Sam Li <sam.li@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Edge VPC cutover timing — playback plan + verification matrix

All — attaching the playback runbook (finalized for our patch window) and a short verification matrix that maps each check to success criteria and quick remediation steps. Highlights: 

1) Pre-bridge (T-1 hour): confirm IAM role propagation to KMS, validate peering routes programmed in both accounts, and verify LB health with 5 synthetic probes.
2) Cutover (T0): flip route target to new Edge subnet, validate 200 OK from two internal probes, check KV cache warming for model shards.
3) Post-cutover (T0+10m, T+30m, T+2h): run observability queries (listed) — baseline comparison to pre-cutover snapshot.

Notes for Sam: if KMS key returns AccessDenied we follow the KMS escalation (Step 7) — do not attempt key rotation without Cases lead approval.

I’ll run the playback on the bridge and call out passes/fails for each matrix item. If we get any failure early (network ACL asymmetry, cross‑AZ LB inconsistencies) we’ll initiate immediate rollback per the runbook.

— Hannah
Lead SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: runbook_playback_v2.pdf, postcutover_observability_checklist.xlsx

Hannah / Nikhil — looks good. I reviewed the checklist and the KMS rationale; a couple clarifications: (a) for the LB probe we need explicit IPs to seed on our side (send me the probe IPs), and (b) please include the NetDiag output template so we can attach to our change ticket. I’ve placed INF-2198 on our side and will join the bridge as change owner.

Schedule still OK from our ops team. Please send the final probe IP list and I’ll confirm the change window.

— Sam

From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-17T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post‑cutover quick readout — Edge VPC activation (summary)

Team — quick post‑mortem from the 02:00–03:15 UTC activation window: cutover completed at 02:12 UTC; primary verification matrix passed 12/13 checks. The single failure was a transient cross‑AZ LB probe (step 4) that resulted in a 502 spike for ~90 seconds; Hannah rolled a targeted LB rule refresh and we saw stabilization at 02:15 UTC. Observability highlights: 95th latency remained within SLA (380ms vs baseline 400ms), error rate returned to baseline by T+5m. Netdiag logs attached.

Action items captured:
- Rishi to follow up with infra on the LB rule root cause and create INF-2202 for a deeper look (expected by 2027-05-20).
- Lauren to share the full playback transcript and bridge recording to the shared Drive folder.
- Vivek to snapshot alert thresholds to ensure we don’t regress on cold startup anomalies.

Closing notes: system stable; no rollback required. Thank you to AcmeCorp infra for the seamless coordination.

— Nikhil
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
